name: ASOIAF answer desk supervisor

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - feature/asoiaf-answer-desk-supervisor-v1
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/asoiaf-answer-desk-supervisor.yml'
      - 'docs/ASOIAF_ANSWER_DESK_SUPERVISOR.md'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'tests/fixtures/asoiaf-answer-desk-fixture.ts'
      - 'tests/fixtures/emit-asoiaf-answer-desk-supervisor-input.ts'
      - 'tests/narrative/canon/asoiaf-answer-desk-supervisor.test.ts'
      - 'tools/asoiaf-answer-desk-supervisor.ts'
      - 'tools/lib/asoiaf-answer-desk-supervisor.ts'
      - 'tools/asoiaf-answer-desk-exchange.ts'
      - 'tools/lib/asoiaf-answer-desk-exchange.ts'
      - 'tools/asoiaf-answer-desk-worker.ts'
      - 'tools/lib/asoiaf-answer-desk-worker.ts'
      - 'tools/asoiaf-answer-desk-estate.ts'
      - 'tools/lib/asoiaf-answer-desk-estate.ts'
      - 'tools/lib/asoiaf-answer-work-lease.ts'
      - 'tools/lib/asoiaf-answer-work-order.ts'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - feature/asoiaf-answer-desk-exchange-v1
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/asoiaf-answer-desk-supervisor.yml'
      - 'docs/ASOIAF_ANSWER_DESK_SUPERVISOR.md'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'tests/fixtures/asoiaf-answer-desk-fixture.ts'
      - 'tests/fixtures/emit-asoiaf-answer-desk-supervisor-input.ts'
      - 'tests/narrative/canon/asoiaf-answer-desk-supervisor.test.ts'
      - 'tools/asoiaf-answer-desk-supervisor.ts'
      - 'tools/lib/asoiaf-answer-desk-supervisor.ts'
      - 'tools/asoiaf-answer-desk-exchange.ts'
      - 'tools/lib/asoiaf-answer-desk-exchange.ts'
      - 'tools/asoiaf-answer-desk-worker.ts'
      - 'tools/lib/asoiaf-answer-desk-worker.ts'
      - 'tools/asoiaf-answer-desk-estate.ts'
      - 'tools/lib/asoiaf-answer-desk-estate.ts'
      - 'tools/lib/asoiaf-answer-work-lease.ts'
      - 'tools/lib/asoiaf-answer-work-order.ts'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: asoiaf-answer-desk-supervisor-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  qualify:
    if: github.repository == 'BigBirdReturns/axm-arc'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 120
    steps:
      - name: Check out exact supervisor candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          show-progress: false

      - name: Record exact candidate identity
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          candidate_sha="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
          printf '%s\n' "$candidate_sha"
          echo "CANDIDATE_SHA=$candidate_sha" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund

      - name: Verify permanent supervisor operator registration
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-supervisor -- help \
            | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/supervisor-help.txt"
          grep -q 'ASOIAF persistent answer desk supervisor' "$RUNNER_TEMP/supervisor-help.txt"
          grep -q 'policy' "$RUNNER_TEMP/supervisor-help.txt"
          grep -q 'plan' "$RUNNER_TEMP/supervisor-help.txt"
          grep -q 'prepare' "$RUNNER_TEMP/supervisor-help.txt"
          grep -q 'tick' "$RUNNER_TEMP/supervisor-help.txt"
          grep -q 'verify' "$RUNNER_TEMP/supervisor-help.txt"

      - name: Strict TypeScript
        id: typecheck
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npm run typecheck | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/typecheck.log"

      - name: Focused supervisor, exchange, worker, estate, lease, answer, dossier, and reconciliation qualification
        id: focused
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npm test -- \
            tests/narrative/canon/asoiaf-answer-desk-supervisor.test.ts \
            tests/narrative/canon/asoiaf-answer-desk-exchange.test.ts \
            tests/narrative/canon/asoiaf-answer-desk-worker.test.ts \
            tests/narrative/canon/asoiaf-answer-desk-estate.test.ts \
            tests/narrative/canon/asoiaf-answer-work-lease.test.ts \
            tests/narrative/canon/asoiaf-answer-work-order.test.ts \
            tests/narrative/canon/asoiaf-reviewed-answer-packet.test.ts \
            tests/narrative/canon/asoiaf-research-question-dossier.test.ts \
            tests/narrative/canon/asoiaf-external-reconciliation-packets.test.ts \
            | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/focused-tests.log"

      - name: Exercise write-ahead JIT scheduling through external review, gap closure, and automatic rendering
        id: smoke
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          fixture_directory="$RUNNER_TEMP/answer-supervisor-fixture"
          estate_root="$RUNNER_TEMP/answer-desk"
          mkdir -p "$fixture_directory"

          npx vite-node tests/fixtures/emit-asoiaf-answer-desk-supervisor-input.ts \
            "$fixture_directory" \
            "$estate_root" \
            | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/fixture-emission.json"

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-desk -- adopt \
            --input "$fixture_directory/adopt-input.json" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/adopt-result.json"

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-supervisor -- plan \
            --input "$fixture_directory/review-tick-input.json" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/supervisor-plan-open.json"

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-supervisor -- prepare \
            --input "$fixture_directory/review-tick-input.json" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/review-prepare.json"

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-desk -- status \
            --root "$estate_root" \
            > "$RUNNER_TEMP/desk-after-prepare.json"

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-supervisor -- tick \
            --input "$fixture_directory/review-tick-input.json" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/review-tick-first.json"

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-supervisor -- tick \
            --input "$fixture_directory/review-tick-input.json" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/review-tick-replay.json"

          node <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const path = require('node:path');
          const temp = process.env.RUNNER_TEMP;
          const fixture = path.join(temp, 'answer-supervisor-fixture');
          const template = JSON.parse(
            fs.readFileSync(path.join(fixture, 'review-result-template.json'), 'utf8'),
          );
          const tick = JSON.parse(
            fs.readFileSync(path.join(temp, 'review-tick-first.json'), 'utf8'),
          );
          template.assignmentId = tick.externalIssue.assignment.assignmentId;
          fs.writeFileSync(
            path.join(fixture, 'review-result-input.json'),
            `${JSON.stringify(template, null, 2)}\n`,
          );
          NODE

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-exchange -- admit \
            --input "$fixture_directory/review-result-input.json" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/review-admit-first.json"

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-exchange -- admit \
            --input "$fixture_directory/review-result-input.json" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/review-admit-replay.json"

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-supervisor -- plan \
            --input "$fixture_directory/close-tick-input.json" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/supervisor-plan-reconciled.json"

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-supervisor -- tick \
            --input "$fixture_directory/close-tick-input.json" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/close-tick-first.json"

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-supervisor -- tick \
            --input "$fixture_directory/close-tick-input.json" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/close-tick-replay.json"

          node <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const path = require('node:path');
          const temp = process.env.RUNNER_TEMP;
          const fixture = path.join(temp, 'answer-supervisor-fixture');
          const template = JSON.parse(
            fs.readFileSync(path.join(fixture, 'close-result-template.json'), 'utf8'),
          );
          const tick = JSON.parse(
            fs.readFileSync(path.join(temp, 'close-tick-first.json'), 'utf8'),
          );
          template.assignmentId = tick.externalIssue.assignment.assignmentId;
          fs.writeFileSync(
            path.join(fixture, 'close-result-input.json'),
            `${JSON.stringify(template, null, 2)}\n`,
          );
          NODE

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-exchange -- admit \
            --input "$fixture_directory/close-result-input.json" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/close-admit-first.json"

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-exchange -- admit \
            --input "$fixture_directory/close-result-input.json" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/close-admit-replay.json"

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-supervisor -- plan \
            --input "$fixture_directory/render-tick-input.json" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/supervisor-plan-ready.json"

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-supervisor -- tick \
            --input "$fixture_directory/render-tick-input.json" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/render-tick-first.json"

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-supervisor -- tick \
            --input "$fixture_directory/render-tick-input.json" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/render-tick-replay.json"

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-supervisor -- status \
            --root "$estate_root" \
            --policy "$fixture_directory/policy.json" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/supervisor-status.json"

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-supervisor -- verify \
            --root "$estate_root" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/supervisor-verification.json"

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-exchange -- status \
            --root "$estate_root" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/exchange-status.json"

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-exchange -- verify \
            --root "$estate_root" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/exchange-verification.json"

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-worker -- status \
            --root "$estate_root" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/worker-status.json"

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-worker -- verify \
            --root "$estate_root" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/worker-verification.json"

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-desk -- status \
            --root "$estate_root" \
            > "$RUNNER_TEMP/desk-status.json"

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-desk -- verify \
            --root "$estate_root" \
            > "$RUNNER_TEMP/desk-verification.json"

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-supervisor -- paths \
            --root "$estate_root" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/supervisor-paths.json"

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-exchange -- paths \
            --root "$estate_root" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/exchange-paths.json"

          npm run --silent asoiaf:answer-worker -- paths \
            --root "$estate_root" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/worker-paths.json"

          node <<'NODE'
          const crypto = require('node:crypto');
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const path = require('node:path');
          const assert = require('node:assert/strict');

          const temp = process.env.RUNNER_TEMP;
          const read = (name) => JSON.parse(
            fs.readFileSync(path.join(temp, name), 'utf8'),
          );
          const fixtureDir = path.join(temp, 'answer-supervisor-fixture');
          const expected = JSON.parse(
            fs.readFileSync(path.join(fixtureDir, 'expected.json'), 'utf8'),
          );
          const policy = JSON.parse(
            fs.readFileSync(path.join(fixtureDir, 'policy.json'), 'utf8'),
          );
          const planOpen = read('supervisor-plan-open.json');
          const prepared = read('review-prepare.json');
          const deskAfterPrepare = read('desk-after-prepare.json');
          const review = read('review-tick-first.json');
          const reviewReplay = read('review-tick-replay.json');
          const reviewAdmit = read('review-admit-first.json');
          const reviewAdmitReplay = read('review-admit-replay.json');
          const planReconciled = read('supervisor-plan-reconciled.json');
          const close = read('close-tick-first.json');
          const closeReplay = read('close-tick-replay.json');
          const closeAdmit = read('close-admit-first.json');
          const closeAdmitReplay = read('close-admit-replay.json');
          const planReady = read('supervisor-plan-ready.json');
          const render = read('render-tick-first.json');
          const renderReplay = read('render-tick-replay.json');
          const supervisorStatus = read('supervisor-status.json');
          const supervisorVerification = read('supervisor-verification.json');
          const exchangeStatus = read('exchange-status.json');
          const exchangeVerification = read('exchange-verification.json');
          const workerStatus = read('worker-status.json');
          const workerVerification = read('worker-verification.json');
          const deskStatus = read('desk-status.json');
          const deskVerification = read('desk-verification.json');
          const supervisorPaths = read('supervisor-paths.json');
          const exchangePaths = read('exchange-paths.json');
          const workerPaths = read('worker-paths.json');

          assert.equal(policy.policyId, expected.policyId);
          assert.equal(policy.policyFingerprint, expected.policyFingerprint);
          assert.equal(policy.networkAccess, 'none');
          assert.equal(policy.privateTextAccess, 'none');
          assert.equal(policy.humanReviewAuthority, 'none');
          assert.equal(policy.acquisitionAuthority, 'none');
          assert.equal(policy.reconciliationAuthority, 'none');

          assert.equal(planOpen.ok, true);
          assert.deepEqual(planOpen.findings, []);
          assert.equal(planOpen.projection.decision.kind, 'issue-external');
          assert.equal(planOpen.projection.decision.itemId, expected.reviewItemId);
          assert.equal(planOpen.projection.decision.action, 'review-exact-locator');
          assert.equal(
            planOpen.projection.decision.actorId,
            'actor:qualification:supervisor-locator-reviewer',
          );
          assert.equal(deskAfterPrepare.counts.leases, 0);
          assert.equal(prepared.replayed, false);
          assert.equal(prepared.intent.decision.itemId, expected.reviewItemId);

          assert.equal(review.intentReplayed, true);
          assert.equal(review.runReplayed, false);
          assert.equal(review.run.outcome, 'external-issued');
          assert.equal(review.run.action, 'review-exact-locator');
          assert.equal(review.externalIssue.claim.replayed, false);
          assert.equal(review.externalIssue.assignmentReplayed, false);
          assert.equal(review.run.operationReferences.length, 1);
          assert.equal(
            review.run.operationReferences[0].kind,
            'answer-exchange-assignment',
          );
          assert.equal(reviewReplay.intentReplayed, true);
          assert.equal(reviewReplay.runReplayed, true);
          assert.equal(reviewReplay.run.runId, review.run.runId);
          assert.equal(reviewReplay.externalIssue, null);

          assert.equal(reviewAdmit.resultReplayed, false);
          assert.equal(reviewAdmit.result.afterWorkOrderId, expected.reconciledWorkOrderId);
          assert.equal(reviewAdmit.settlement.replayed, false);
          assert.equal(reviewAdmitReplay.resultReplayed, true);
          assert.equal(reviewAdmitReplay.settlement.replayed, true);

          assert.equal(planReconciled.ok, true);
          assert.equal(planReconciled.projection.decision.kind, 'issue-external');
          assert.equal(planReconciled.projection.decision.itemId, expected.closeItemId);
          assert.equal(planReconciled.projection.decision.action, 'close-gap');
          assert.equal(
            planReconciled.projection.decision.actorId,
            'actor:qualification:supervisor-answer-assembler',
          );

          assert.equal(close.intentReplayed, false);
          assert.equal(close.runReplayed, false);
          assert.equal(close.run.outcome, 'external-issued');
          assert.equal(close.run.action, 'close-gap');
          assert.equal(close.externalIssue.claim.replayed, false);
          assert.equal(closeReplay.runReplayed, true);
          assert.equal(closeReplay.run.runId, close.run.runId);
          assert.equal(closeReplay.externalIssue, null);

          assert.equal(closeAdmit.resultReplayed, false);
          assert.equal(closeAdmit.result.afterWorkOrderId, expected.readyWorkOrderId);
          assert.equal(closeAdmit.settlement.replayed, false);
          assert.equal(closeAdmitReplay.resultReplayed, true);
          assert.equal(closeAdmitReplay.settlement.replayed, true);

          assert.equal(planReady.ok, true);
          assert.equal(planReady.projection.decision.kind, 'run-automatic');
          assert.equal(planReady.projection.decision.itemId, expected.renderItemId);
          assert.equal(planReady.projection.decision.action, 'render-reviewed-answer');

          assert.equal(render.intentReplayed, false);
          assert.equal(render.runReplayed, false);
          assert.equal(render.run.outcome, 'automatic-rendered');
          assert.equal(render.run.action, 'render-reviewed-answer');
          assert.equal(render.automaticRun.claim.replayed, false);
          assert.equal(render.automaticRun.invocationReplayed, false);
          assert.equal(render.automaticRun.resultReplayed, false);
          assert.equal(render.automaticRun.settlement.replayed, false);
          assert.deepEqual(
            render.run.operationReferences.map((entry) => entry.kind),
            [
              'answer-worker-invocation',
              'answer-worker-result',
              'reviewed-answer-render',
              'answer-work-settlement',
            ],
          );
          assert.equal(renderReplay.runReplayed, true);
          assert.equal(renderReplay.run.runId, render.run.runId);
          assert.equal(renderReplay.automaticRun, null);

          assert.equal(supervisorStatus.ok, true);
          assert.equal(supervisorStatus.counts.intents, 3);
          assert.equal(supervisorStatus.counts.runs, 3);
          assert.equal(supervisorStatus.counts.pendingIntents, 0);
          assert.equal(supervisorStatus.counts.automaticAvailable, 0);
          assert.equal(supervisorStatus.counts.externalAvailable, 0);
          assert.equal(supervisorStatus.projection.decision.kind, 'idle');
          assert.deepEqual(supervisorStatus.pendingIntentIds, []);

          assert.equal(exchangeStatus.ok, true);
          assert.equal(exchangeStatus.counts.assignments, 2);
          assert.equal(exchangeStatus.counts.results, 2);
          assert.equal(workerStatus.ok, true);
          assert.equal(workerStatus.counts.invocations, 1);
          assert.equal(workerStatus.counts.results, 1);
          assert.equal(deskStatus.ok, true);
          assert.equal(deskStatus.counts.workOrders, 3);
          assert.equal(deskStatus.counts.leases, 3);
          assert.equal(deskStatus.counts.settlements, 3);
          assert.deepEqual(deskStatus.state.availableItemIds, []);
          assert.equal(deskStatus.state.nextAvailableItemId, null);

          for (const verification of [
            supervisorVerification,
            exchangeVerification,
            workerVerification,
            deskVerification,
          ]) {
            assert.equal(verification.ok, true);
            assert.deepEqual(
              verification.findings.filter((entry) => entry.severity === 'error'),
              [],
            );
          }

          assert.equal(fs.readdirSync(supervisorPaths.intents).length, 3);
          assert.equal(fs.readdirSync(supervisorPaths.runs).length, 3);
          assert.equal(
            fs.readdirSync(supervisorPaths.intents).every(
              (name) => /^[a-f0-9]{64}\.json$/.test(name),
            ),
            true,
          );
          assert.equal(
            fs.readdirSync(supervisorPaths.runs).every(
              (name) => /^[a-f0-9]{64}\.json$/.test(name),
            ),
            true,
          );
          assert.equal(fs.readdirSync(exchangePaths.assignments).length, 2);
          assert.equal(fs.readdirSync(exchangePaths.results).length, 2);
          assert.equal(fs.readdirSync(workerPaths.invocations).length, 1);
          assert.equal(fs.readdirSync(workerPaths.results).length, 1);
          assert.equal(fs.readdirSync(workerPaths.outputs).length, 1);

          for (const assignment of exchangeStatus.assignments) {
            assert.equal(assignment.privateTextIncluded, false);
            assert.equal(assignment.sourceTextIncluded, false);
            assert.equal(assignment.authority, 'none');
            assert.equal(assignment.graphEffect, 'none');
            assert.equal(assignment.canonEffect, 'none');
            assert.equal(assignment.answerEffect, 'none');
          }
          for (const intent of supervisorStatus.intents) {
            assert.equal(intent.authority, 'none');
            assert.equal(intent.graphEffect, 'none');
            assert.equal(intent.canonEffect, 'none');
            assert.equal(intent.answerEffect, 'none');
          }
          for (const run of supervisorStatus.runs) {
            assert.equal(run.authority, 'none');
            assert.equal(run.graphEffect, 'none');
            assert.equal(run.canonEffect, 'none');
            assert.equal(run.answerEffect, 'none');
          }

          const renderReference = render.automaticRun.result.resultReferences.find(
            (reference) => reference.kind === 'reviewed-answer-render',
          );
          assert.ok(renderReference);
          const outputPath = path.resolve(expected.estateRoot, renderReference.uri);
          const output = fs.readFileSync(outputPath, 'utf8');
          assert.equal([...output].length, expected.renderedTextCharacters);
          assert.equal(
            `sha256:${crypto.createHash('sha256').update(output).digest('hex')}`,
            expected.renderedTextDigest,
          );
          assert.equal(
            fs.existsSync(path.join(expected.estateRoot, '.transaction-lock')),
            false,
          );
          NODE

      - name: Complete Arc regression
        id: regression
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npm test | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/full-tests.log"

      - name: Production build
        id: build
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npm run build | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/build.log"

      - name: Retain exact supervisor qualification
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root='asoiaf-answer-desk-supervisor-qualification'
          mkdir -p "$root"
          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP"/*.txt "$root/" 2>/dev/null || true
          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP"/*.log "$root/" 2>/dev/null || true
          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP"/*.json "$root/" 2>/dev/null || true
          if [ -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/answer-supervisor-fixture" ]; then
            cp -R "$RUNNER_TEMP/answer-supervisor-fixture" "$root/fixture"
          fi
          if [ -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/answer-desk" ]; then
            cp -R "$RUNNER_TEMP/answer-desk" "$root/estate"
          fi
          printf '%s\n' "$CANDIDATE_SHA" > "$root/candidate-sha.txt"
          printf '%s\n' \
            'selection=work-order-order-then-binding-priority' \
            'leases=claim-only-on-dispatch' \
            'writeAheadIntent=content-addressed' \
            'requestReplay=exact' \
            'externalDispatch=actor-role-capacity-bound' \
            'automaticDispatch=reviewed-renderer-only' \
            'networkAccess=none' \
            'privateTextAccess=none' \
            'humanReviewAuthority=none' \
            'acquisitionAuthority=none' \
            'reconciliationAuthority=none' \
            'graphEffect=none' \
            'canonEffect=none' \
            'answerEffect=none' \
            > "$root/qualification-boundary.txt"
          find "$root" -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0 \
            | sort -z \
            | xargs -0 sha256sum \
            | sed "s#  $root/#  #" \
            > "$root/SHA256SUMS"

      - name: Upload supervisor qualification
        if: always()
        id: upload
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: asoiaf-answer-desk-supervisor-qualification
          path: asoiaf-answer-desk-supervisor-qualification
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Publish exact qualification summary
        if: always()
        env:
          ARTIFACT_ID: ${{ steps.upload.outputs['artifact-id'] }}
          ARTIFACT_DIGEST: ${{ steps.upload.outputs['artifact-digest'] }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          {
            echo '## ASOIAF answer desk supervisor qualification'
            echo
            echo "- Candidate: \`$CANDIDATE_SHA\`"
            echo "- Artifact: \`${ARTIFACT_ID:-not-issued}\`"
            echo "- Artifact digest: \`${ARTIFACT_DIGEST:-not-issued}\`"
            echo '- Scheduler: write-ahead JIT intent, one decision per tick.'
            echo '- External work: actor-role capacity bound.'
            echo '- Automatic work: reviewed renderer only.'
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
